instructions: better-auth-id-jag is a pair of Better Auth plugins, an ID-JAG issuer and an ID-JAG receiver, following draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant-06. Put security and correctness first. When a comment is about protocol behaviour, name the section of the draft or the RFC it rests on. Skip formatting points that Biome (biome.jsonc) already enforces.
